subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Bearing Life: How Long Will It Last?
description: A quick, practical guide to Bearing Life: How Long Will It Last?.

hook.text: Every bearing will eventually fail. Engineers need to predict when.

buildup.text: L10 life is the revolutions 90% of identical bearings survive.

discovery.text: Life drops with the cube of load. Double the load, cut life eightfold.

twist.text: Real life varies widely. Dirt and misalignment kill bearings early.

climax.text: Clean oil, proper mounting, and correct load can triple predicted life.

punchline.text: A bearing's life depends more on care than on steel.

quiz.question: What does L10 bearing life represent?
options: Revolutions at which 10% of bearings in a group are expected to fail
Average life of all bearings tested under load
Hours the bearing can run without lubrication
